name: q119
question:
Is there a limit to human intelligence?
IQ test scores appear to have increased by about 30 points during the 20th century, according to experts interviewed in a recent BBC documentary. Overall, increased quality of nutrition, better education, and greater exposure to new technologies have all contributed to our intelligence increasing. Some scientists purport that we will never hit a limit to our intelligence because there will always be new problems to solve and challenges to navigate. It may be a cycle in which more intelligence begets more solutions and new solutions beget more intelligence. So, is there a limit to human intelligence? “We have no idea,” says developmental and psychological scientist Tenelle Porter in the documentary, adding, “We’ve only scratched the surface.”
title: Is there a limit to human intelligence?
